questions.q: $62.5\%$ of a number exceeds $25\%$ of the same number by 15. What is the number? (PHASE XIII(GRAD) - 31/07/2025 - SHIFT 3)
questions.s:
Core Conceptual Tool: 5. Unitary Scaling

Pen-Free Observation: Dekh bhai, sidha difference dikh raha hai. $62.5\% - 25\% = 37.5\%$. Aur $37.5\%$ ki standard fraction $3/8$ hoti hai. Dimaag me set rakh isko!

Method 1 (Ninja Technique / Exam Approach): $3/8$ part ki value 15 hai. 3 part 15 hain toh 1 part 5 hoga. Pura number 8 part hai, toh $8 \times 5 = 40$. Seconds ka game hai ye.

Mathematically :-
$62.5\% - 25\% = 37.5\%$
$37.5\% = \frac{3}{8}$
$\frac{3}{8} \equiv 15 \implies 1 \equiv 5$
$\text{Num} = 8 \times 5 = 40$

Method 2 (Concept Builder): Basic equation $0.625x - 0.25x = 15$ likh ke solve kar le. Lekin decimals exam me rulate hain, hamesha fractions use kar.

Mathematically :-
$0.625x - 0.25x = 15$
$0.375x = 15$
$x = \frac{15}{0.375} = 40$

Exam Takeaway: Percentage difference agar standard fraction ho toh seedha numerator-denominator ka khel khel.

PercentFraction
$37.5\%$$3/8$

questions.q: In a company, the number of employees increases by x% and also their working hours increases by x%. Due to this, the production of company increases by 74.24%. Find the initial number of employees in company, if total 240 new employees joined the company.
questions.s:
Core Conceptual Tool: Successive Change

Pen-Free Observation: Dekh bhai, production 2 cheezon ka product hai (Employees aur Hours). Dono $x\%$ badhe hain. Total $74.24\%$ badha, yaani naya multiplier $1.7424$ ho gaya. Ye seedha dikh raha hai ki $1.32$ ka square hai. Matlab $x = 32$.

Method 1 (Ninja Technique): Multiplier ka square root le kar seedha answer nikalo.

Mathematically :-
$$(1 + \frac{x}{100})^2 = 1.7424 \\\\ 1 + \frac{x}{100} = 1.32 \\\\ x = 32 \\\\ 32\% = 240 \\\\ 100\% = \frac{240}{32} \times 100 = 750$$

Method 2 (Concept Builder): Basic successive percentage addition formula lagao.

Mathematically :-
$$x + x + \frac{x^2}{100} = 74.24 \\\\ x = 32 \\\\ 0.32 \times E = 240 \\\\ E = \frac{240}{0.32} = 750$$

Exam Takeaway: $1$ se $50$ tak squares yaad hain toh $74.24$ dekh ke dimaag me ghanti bajegi ki ye $1.32$ ka square ($1.7424$) ka format hai.

List IList II
Successive (Same Rate)Total $\%$ Change = $2x + \frac{x^2}{100}$

questions.q: The income of A is 10,800 per month. He saves $12.5\%$ of his income. If his monthly income increases by $22.5\%$ and the expenditure increases by $30\%$, then his monthly savings decreases by
questions.s:
Core Conceptual Tool: JSM (Junior Satisfaction Method)

Pen-Free Observation: Base values pe sidhe percentage deviation multiply kar ke net effect check karle. Original absolute value baad mein map karna.

Method 1 (Ninja Technique / Exam Approach): Save $= 12.5\%$ ($1/8$). Income = 8 unit, Save = 1 unit, Exp = 7 unit. Net savings change $= (8 \times 22.5) - (7 \times 30) = 180 - 210 = -30$ units (on a 800 scale). $800u = 10800$, toh $1u = 13.5$. Drop $= 30 \times 13.5 = 405$. Absolute killer method!

Method 2 (Concept Builder): Basic values nikal (Inc=10800, Sav=1350) fir unpe percentage laga. Calculation exam mein saara time kha jayegi.

Exam Takeaway: Exact value ko hamesha last mein touch karna, pehle unit deviation nikal lo.

questions.q: In a school, $50\%$ of the students play cricket, $40\%$ of the students play football and the number of students who play both games is 420. The number of students who play neither cricket nor football is $45\%$. Find the total number of students in the school.
questions.s:
The "Pen-Free" Observation First:

Dekh bhai, $45\%$ kuch nahi khelte, matlab $55\%$ kuch toh khelte hain. Venn diagram ka union $55\%$ hai. Cricket ($50\%$) + Football ($40\%$) = $90\%$. Intersection kya hoga? $90\% - 55\% = 35\%$. Ab $35\%$ ki value 420 di hai. $1\% = 12$, toh $100\% = 1200$. Pen uthane ki zaroorat hi nahi thi!

Method 1 (Concept Builder):

Mathematically :-

$$ n(C \cup F) = 100\% - 45\% = 55\% \\ n(C \cap F) = n(C) + n(F) - n(C \cup F) \\ n(C \cap F) = 50\% + 40\% - 55\% = 35\% \\ 35\% \rightarrow 420 \\ 1\% \rightarrow 12 \\ 100\% \rightarrow 1200 $$

Exam Takeaway: Seedha divisibility check kar, 12 ka multiple option me ek hi hai. Mental Venn diagram hi best approach hai exam ke liye!

Core Conceptual Tool: Unitary Scaling.

Pen-Free Observation: Dekh bhai, standard fractions ko pehchan aur zero cancel kar seedha answer nikal le dimag me.

Method 1 (Ninja Technique / Exam Approach): Mental fractions. Mathematically :-
$$80\% \rightarrow \frac{4}{5}$$
$$37.5\% \rightarrow \frac{3}{8}$$
$$280 - 60 + 55 = 275$$

Method 2 (Concept Builder): Step by step scaling. Mathematically :-
$$\frac{4}{5} \times 350 - \frac{3}{8} \times 160 + \frac{11}{100} \times 500$$
$$280 - 60 + 55 = 275$$

Exam Takeaway: Fractional equivalents dimag me set hone chahiye, tabhi speed badhegi simplification me.

List IList II
Standard values$37.5\% = 3/8, 80\% = 4/5$

questions.q: For a number, greater than one, the difference between itself and its reciprocal is 20% of the sum of itself and its reciprocal. By how much percentage (nearest to an integer) is the square of the number less than its cube?
questions.s:
Core Conceptual Tool: 5. Unitary Scaling

Pen-Free Observation: Dekh bhai, language thodi ghumau hai par basic algebraic equation ban rahi hai. Cross multiply karke seedha number ka square nikal lena sabse asaan hoga.

Method 1 (Ninja Technique / Exam Approach): Equation ko fraction ki tarah set kar, solve karke cube aur square ka ratio nikal de!

Mathematically :-
$$x - \frac{1}{x} = 0.2\left(x + \frac{1}{x}\right) \implies \frac{x - \frac{1}{x}}{x + \frac{1}{x}} = \frac{1}{5}$$
$$5x - \frac{5}{x} = x + \frac{1}{x} \implies 4x = \frac{6}{x} \implies x^2 = 1.5$$
$$x = \sqrt{1.5} \approx 1.2247$$
$$\text{Req } \% = \frac{x^3 - x^2}{x^3} \times 100 = \left(1 - \frac{1}{x}\right) \times 100$$
$$\left(1 - \frac{1}{1.2247}\right) \times 100 \approx (1 - 0.816) \times 100 \approx 18.3\% \approx 18\%$$

Method 2 (Concept Builder): Absolute values pe ja kar cube nikalega aur square nikalega toh decimals me jaakar puri tarah fass jayega. Seedha ratio utha.

Mathematically :-
$$\text{Req } \% = \frac{A-B}{A} \times 100 = \left(1 - \frac{B}{A}\right) \times 100$$

Exam Takeaway: Percentage less/more pooche algebra me toh hamesha unka ratio $\frac{A}{B}$ form me convert kar lo, original absolute values ki tension khatam ho jayegi.

List IList II
% Less of A wrt B$(1 - \frac{A}{B}) \times 100$

questions.q: x is inversely proportional to y. If x is increased by $37.5\%$ then find % change in the value of y?
questions.s:
Core Conceptual Tool: 1. CPR (Constant Product Ratio)

Pen-Free Observation: Dekh bhai, $x$ aur $y$ inversely proportional hain, iska matlab unka product $x \times y = K$ constant hai. Direct CPR shift lagega.

Method 1 (Ninja Technique / Exam Approach): $37.5\%$ ki fraction $3/8$ hoti hai. X me increase hua $+3/8$. Toh CPR shift me Y decrease hoga $-3/(8+3) = -3/11$. $1/11$ hota hai $9.09\%$, toh $3/11$ banega $27.27\%$. Aankhon hi aankhon me answer!

Mathematically :-
$X_{inc} = +\frac{3}{8}$
$Y_{dec} = -\frac{3}{11}$
$\% = \frac{3}{11} \times 100 = 27.27\%$

Method 2 (Concept Builder): Ratio se dekh le. $x$ agar 8 se 11 hua, toh inverse relation me $y$ 11 se 8 hoga. 3 ghata 11 par. Baakhi kahani same hai.

Mathematically :-
$xy = k$
$X_{new} = \frac{11}{8}x$
$Y_{new} = \frac{k}{\frac{11}{8}x} = \frac{8}{11}y$
$\text{Dec} = y - \frac{8}{11}y = \frac{3}{11}y$
$\% = \frac{3}{11} \times 100 = 27.27\%$

Exam Takeaway: Inversely proportional bolne ka matlab hi CPR lagana hai, fractions yaad hone chahiye tips par.

VariableShift
X (Increase)$+3/8$
Y (Decrease)$-3/11$

questions.q: The population of a village was (3x + 1000). In a year, with the increase in population of males by 9.33% and that of females by 8%, the population of the village became 17400. The number of males increased are (x + 4000), then find the value of x.
questions.s:
Core Conceptual Tool: JSM/Deviation

Pen-Free Observation: Dekh bhai, mixed variables wala quadratic sawal hai. Isko equation se solve karna self-sabotage hai. Seedha pehla option $5000$ le aur values confirm kar. Round figure values se math ekdum match ho jayega.

Method 1 (Ninja Technique): Option testing udao seedha check karo increase amount.

Mathematically :-
$$Let \ x = 5000 \\\\ Initial \ Total = 3(5000) + 1000 = 16000 \\\\ Final \ Total = 17400 \Rightarrow Inc = 1400 \\\\ Males = 5000 + 4000 = 9000, \ Females = 16000 - 9000 = 7000 \\\\ Male \ Inc = 9000 \times \frac{28}{300} = 840 \\\\ Female \ Inc = 7000 \times \frac{8}{100} = 560 \\\\ Total \ Inc = 840 + 560 = 1400 \ (Condition \ Satisfied!)$$

Method 2 (Concept Builder): Variable x rakh kar proper linear system setup karna.

Mathematically :-
$$M = x + 4000 \\\\ F = (3x + 1000) - (x + 4000) = 2x - 3000 \\\\ Inc = 17400 - (3x + 1000) = 16400 - 3x \\\\ (x + 4000)\times\frac{28}{300} + (2x - 3000)\times\frac{8}{100} = 16400 - 3x \\\\ \text{(Too lengthy, directly yields } x = 5000)$$

Exam Takeaway: Variables dekhte hi Option elimination is the ultimate key. Quadratic solve karne par time waste hota hai.

List IList II
Option HackingAlway start with round figures (like 5000) for clean calculations.

questions.q: In an examination a candidate had to sit for three papers A, B and C. The candidate secured 75% marks in Paper A, 80% marks in Paper B, and 60% marks in Paper C. If the weightage assigned to Papers A, B and C were 40%, 50% and 10%, respectively, then find the weighted percentage of marks obtained by the candidate, when all three papers were taken together.
questions.s:
Tool Triggered: 3. JSM/Deviation

The "Pen-Free" Observation First:
Dekh bhai, weights ka ratio 4:5:1 hai. Base mark $75\%$ maan le. A me deviation 0. B me $+5\%$ ka deviation hai 5 weights pe ($+25$). C me $-15\%$ ka deviation hai 1 weight pe ($-15$). Net deviation = $+10$. Isko total 10 weights me baant de. $+1\%$ aayega. $75 + 1 = 76\%$. Aman Bhaiya ka JSM zindabad!

Method 1 (Ninja Technique):
JSM application on weights.

Mathematically :-
$$ \text{Weights} = 4 : 5 : 1 \quad (Total = 10) \\ \text{Scores} = 75\%, 80\%, 60\% \\ \text{Assume Base} = 75\% \\ \text{Deviations} = 0\%, +5\%, -15\% \\ \text{Net Deviation} = (4 \times 0) + (5 \times 5) + (1 \times -15) = +25 - 15 = +10 \\ \text{Average Change} = \frac{+10}{10} = +1\% \\ \text{Final} = 75\% + 1\% = 76\% $$

Method 2 (Concept Builder):
Standard weighted average.

Mathematically :-
$$ \text{Weighted Avg} = \frac{W_1 S_1 + W_2 S_2 + W_3 S_3}{W_1 + W_2 + W_3} \\ = \frac{4(75) + 5(80) + 1(60)}{10} \\ = \frac{300 + 400 + 60}{10} = \frac{760}{10} = 76\% $$

Exam Takeaway: Weighted average ke questions bas JSM practice check karte hain. Calculation easy thi isliye simple method bhi fast hai.

questions.q: The cost of packaging of the mangoes is 40% the cost of fresh mangoes themselves. The cost of mangoes increased by 30% but the cost of packaging decreases by 50%, then the percentage change of the cost of packed mangoes, if the cost of packed mangoes is equal to the sum of the cost of fresh mangoes and cost of packaging:
questions.s:
**Core Conceptual Tool:** 5. Unitary Scaling

**Pen-Free Observation:** Dekh bhai aise karna hai... Product aur packaging dono alag rate se badh/ghat rahe hain. Direct base 100 maan, add kar, aur nayi values compare kar le.

**Method 1 (Ninja Technique / Exam Approach):** Mangoes ki cost 100 maan, packaging ho gayi 40. Total ho gaya 140. Ab mangoes 30\% badh kar 130 hue, aur packaging 50\% ghat kar 20 reh gayi. Naya total = 130 + 20 = 150. Increment aya 10 ka, kis par? Purane 140 par! Fraction bana $\frac{10}{140} = \frac{1}{14}$. Direct fraction yaad honi chahiye, $\frac{1}{14}$ matlab 7.14\% Hota hai!

**Method 2 (Concept Builder):** Concept ye hai ki 'Total Cost' par directly overall percentage nahi lagta jab tak uske internal components alag-alag vary kar rahe hon. Individual parts ka naya sum nikalo tabhi sahi value aayegi.

**Exam Takeaway:** Aise combined cost wale sawaalo me turant 100 base par shift kar jao. $\frac{1}{14} = 7.14\%$ jaise fraction tips par hone chahiye.

questions.q: In a factory with 400 employees, the ratio of the number of male employees to that of female employees is 5:3. There are $87.5\%$ regular employees in the factory. If $92\%$ of male employees are regular employees, then what is the percentage of regular female employees?
questions.s:
Core Conceptual Tool: 3. JSM (Junior Satisfaction Method) / Deviation

Pen-Free Observation: Dekh bhai, total $400$ employees sirf daraane aur exam ka time kharab karne ke liye diye hain. Jab final answer percentage me pucha ho aur initial data ratio aur $\%$ me ho, absolute value chhuo bhi mat.

Method 1 (Ninja Technique / Exam Approach): M:F ka ratio $5:3$ hai. Overall regular average ko base maan aur deviation check kar. Bin pen ud gaya sawal!

Mathematically :-
$$ M:F = 5:3 \\\\ Avg_{total} = 87.5\\% \\\\ Dev_M = 92\\% - 87.5\\% = +4.5\\% \\\\ Total \\ Dev_M = 5 \\times 4.5\\% = +22.5\\% \\\\ Dev_F = \\frac{-22.5\\%}{3} = -7.5\\% \\\\ F\\% = 87.5\\% - 7.5\\% = 80\\% $$

Method 2 (Concept Builder): Gadha mazdoori mode on kar: pehle values nikal fir minus karke percentage. Bahot lamba.

Mathematically :-
$$ M = 250, \\ F = 150 \\\\ M_{reg} = 250 \\times 92\\% = 230 \\\\ Total_{reg} = 400 \\times 87.5\\% = 350 \\\\ F_{reg} = 350 - 230 = 120 \\\\ F\\% = \\frac{120}{150} \\times 100 = 80\\% $$

Exam Takeaway: JSM aur deviation weighted mean ka baap hai, jab absolute figure ki jarurat na ho, ratio pe chipke raho.

questions.q: The income of a person first increases by 25% and then decreases by 25%. What percentage is the new income of the original income?
questions.s:
Core Conceptual Tool Triggered: Successive Change (The Chain Reaction)

The 'Pen-Free' Observation First: Same percentage badh kar ghat raha hai, matlab loss hi hoga. Aur loss nikal ke 100 se minus karna hai kyuki 'new income' pucha hai, 'change' nahi.

Method 1 (Ninja Technique / Exam Approach): Dekh bhai aise karna hai... Same percentage increase/decrease me humesha $-\frac{x^2}{100}$ ka net change aata hai. Yaha $\frac{25^2}{100} = 6.25$ ka decrease. Original 100 tha, toh bacha $100 - 6.25 = 93.75$%. Seedha tick maar!

Method 2 (Concept Builder):
ConceptFormula
A. Same +x% and -x%1. $-\frac{x^2}{100}$% (Always Loss)
B. Diff +a% and +b%2. $a + b + \frac{ab}{100}$%

Future Exam Takeaway: CDS me ye standard trap hai, question dhyan se padh ki 'change' pucha hai ya 'new value'.

questions.q: In a manufacturing unit, it was noted that the price of raw material has increased by $12.5\%$ and the labour cost has gone up from $25\%$ of the cost of raw material to $30\%$ of the NEW cost of raw material. By what percentage must the consumption of raw material be reduced to keep the total cost the same? (Approximate)
questions.s:
The "Pen-Free" Observation First:

Dekh bhai, $12.5\%$ ka fraction $\frac{1}{8}$ hota hai. Raw material 8 se 9 ho gaya. Purana labour 8 ka $25\%$ yani 2 tha. Naya labour 9 ka $30\%$ yani 2.7 hai. Purani total cost 10, nayi 11.7. Budget fix hai toh consumption theek cost ke ulte ratio me giregi (CPR).

Method 1 (Ninja Technique):

Mathematically :-

$$ \text{RM (Old : New)} = 8 : 9 \\ \text{Labour (Old)} = 8 \times \frac{25}{100} = 2 \\ \text{Labour (New)} = 9 \times \frac{30}{100} = 2.7 \\ \text{Total Cost (Old : New)} = (8+2) : (9+2.7) = 10 : 11.7 = 100 : 117 \\ \text{Consumption Ratio} = 117 : 100 \\ \text{Percentage Reduction} = \frac{17}{117} \times 100 \approx 14.53\% $$

Exam Takeaway: Jab jeb mein paisa fixed ho (Budget = Constant), toh Price ratio ka ulta Consumption ratio hota hai. CPR is the ultimate tool!

questions.q: The price of a commodity increased by 22%. By what percentage (correct to two decimal places) should its consumption be reduced so that the total expenditure remains the same?
questions.s:
Core Conceptual Tool: CPR.

Pen-Free Observation: Dekh bhai, expenditure same rakhna hai matlab Price ratio ka direct reverse Consumption ratio hoga. 100 ki cheez 122 ho gayi, wapis 100 aana hai.

Method 1 (Ninja Technique / Exam Approach): CPR lagake sidha nikal. $\frac{x}{y}$ bada toh $\frac{x}{x+y}$ kam hoga. Mathematically :-

$P \uparrow \frac{22}{100} = \frac{11}{50}$

$C \downarrow \frac{11}{50+11} = \frac{11}{61}$

$\frac{11}{61} \times 100 = \frac{1100}{61} \approx 18.03\%$

Method 2 (Concept Builder): Base 100 leke consumption reduce kar. Mathematically :-

$\text{New Price} = 122$

$\text{Reduction Req} = 22$

$\text{Red } \% = \frac{22}{122} \times 100 = \frac{1100}{61}$

$\approx 18.032\%$

Exam Takeaway: Inverse proportion ke concepts mein direct fraction adjustment (CPR) use karke base identify kiya karo.

List IList II
CPR Rule$\uparrow \frac{N}{D} \Rightarrow \downarrow \frac{N}{N+D}$

questions.q: A fruit seller had some apples and oranges. He sold $25\%$ apples to person A, $30\%$ of the remaining to person B and had 42 apples left. Similarly, he sold $30\%$ oranges to A, 60 oranges to B and had $20\%$ Oranges left. What is the total number of apples and oranges that the fruit seller had initially?
questions.s:
Core Conceptual Tool: 2. Successive Change & 5. Unitary Scaling

Pen-Free Observation: Apples me 'remaining' shabd hai matlab successive multiplication chalega. Oranges me flat value ($60$) hai matlab normal line method (unitary scaling) lagega.

Method 1 (Ninja Technique / Exam Approach): Apples me seedha chain multiply maar aur oranges me percentage remaining compare karke beech ki value nikal. Free ke marks hain!

Mathematically :-
$$ A \\times \\frac{3}{4} \\times \\frac{7}{10} = 42 \\\\ A = 80 \\\\ O_{B\\%} = 100\\% - (30\\% + 20\\%) = 50\\% \\\\ 50\\% \\ of \\ O = 60 \\\\ O = 120 \\\\ Total = 80 + 120 = 200 $$

Method 2 (Concept Builder): Apples ko $100x$ maan aur oranges ko $100y$. Fractions isilye best hote hain.

Mathematically :-
$$ Let \\ A = 100x \\\\ A_{left} = 100x - 25x - (0.3 \\times 75x) = 52.5x \\\\ 52.5x = 42 \\implies x = 0.8 \\implies A = 80 \\\\ Let \\ O = 100y \\\\ O_{B} = 100y - 30y - 20y = 50y \\\\ 50y = 60 \\implies y = 1.2 \\implies O = 120 \\\\ Total = 80 + 120 = 200 $$

Exam Takeaway: Question ki language padhte hi samajh aana chahiye ki chain rule (successive) lagana hai ya absolute line scaling lagani hai.

List I (Fruit Calculation)List II (Result)
A. Apples ($X \times \frac{3}{4} \times \frac{7}{10} = 42$)1. $80$
B. Oranges ($50\% = 60$)2. $120$

questions.q: In a school the number of students who reads math only is double to who reads only English and the number of students who reads both is one third to who did not read any. If 28 students read both subject and 400 students are in the school (i) Find number of student who read only English (ii) Find number of student who read Math.
questions.s:
Tool Triggered: 5. Unitary Scaling

The "Pen-Free" Observation First:
Dekh bhai, Both = 28. Neither = $28 \times 3 = 84$. Total bach gaye: $400 - (28+84) = 288$. Ye 288 bache sirf Only Math aur Only English ke. Ratio Only_Math : Only_Eng = 2:1. Yani 3 parts = 288, 1 part (Only English) = 96. Total Math padhne wale = Only Math (192) + Both (28) = 220. Option 1 straight matching!

Method 1 (Ninja Technique):
Mental Venn Diagram.

Mathematically :-
$$ B = 28, \quad N = 3 \times 28 = 84 \\ M_o + E_o = 400 - (B + N) = 400 - 112 = 288 \\ M_o = 2E_o \implies 3E_o = 288 \implies E_o = 96 \\ M_{\text{Total}} = M_o + B = 192 + 28 = 220 $$

Method 2 (Concept Builder):
Full Set Theory expansion.

Mathematically :-
$$ U = M \cup E + N \\ M \cup E = M_o + E_o + B \\ U = M_o + E_o + B + N \\ 400 = 2x + x + 28 + (3 \times 28) \\ 400 = 3x + 112 \implies 3x = 288 \implies x = 96 \\ \text{Only English} = x = 96 \\ \text{Math Total} = M_o + B = 2x + 28 = 192 + 28 = 220 $$

Exam Takeaway: Set theory without formulas, sirf parts ke form me visualise karo.

questions.q: Two numbers are less than a third number by 30% and 37% respectively. The percent by which the second number is less than the first is?
questions.s:
Core Conceptual Tool: 5. Unitary Scaling

Pen-Free Observation: CGL me hamesha is word "than the first" pe focus kar, kyuki wahi tera denominator base set karta hai. Seedhi percentages minus karne ka game nahi hai ye.

Method 1 (Ninja Technique / Exam Approach): Dekh bhai, seedha Third number ko 100 maan.
Toh First hua $= 70$. Second hua $= 63$.
Pucha kya hai? Second first se kitna chota hai?
Difference $= 70 - 63 = 7$.
Percentage on First $= \frac{7}{70} \times 100 = 10\%$.
Options me 7% janbujh kar rakha gaya hai taki bache fatafat $37-30=7$ mark karein aur gadhe kehlayein.

Method 2 (Concept Builder): Step by step: Identify Base $\rightarrow$ Shift Base $\rightarrow$ Compare. Wahi base rule.

Exam Takeaway: English ke "than" aur "of" shabd ke theek baad aane wala word humesha denominator banta hai, yaad rakhio.

Base RuleWarning
Relative ComparisonAlways check the 'than' keyword to identify the denominator base.

questions.q: Forty per cent of the employees of a certain company are men, and $75\%$ of the men earn more than $\text{Rs. } 38$,000 per year. If $48\%$ of the company's employees earn more than $\text{Rs. } 38$,000 per year, what fraction of the women employed by the company earn less than or equal to $\text{Rs. } 38$,000 per year?
questions.s:
[Core Tool Triggered: JSM / Deviation (Tree Diagram)]

Pen-Free Observation: Data straight hai, base $100$ maan kar split kar de. Total men 40, women 60 hain. Target 'women $\le 38k$' nikalna hai.



Method 1 isme tum female ka % nikalne ke bajay tum female ka total pop se compare karne lagte ho jo ki galat hai aisa repeated karte ho(Ninja Technique):
Let Total Employees $= 100$.
Men $= 40$, Women $= 60$.
Men $> 38k = 75\%$ of $40 = 30$.
Total employees $> 38k = 48$.
Toh Women $> 38k$ kitni hui? $48 - 30 = 18$.
Humein un aurto ka fraction chahiye jo $\le 38k$ kamati hain. Wo hongi $60 - 18 = 42$.
Fraction $= \frac{\text{Women } \le 38k}{\text{Total Women}} = \frac{42}{60}= \frac{7}{10}$.

Method 2 (Concept Builder):
Tree banane se accuracy $100\%$ rehti hai. Language dhyan se padh 'fraction of the women' pucha hai, 'fraction of total employees' nahi, isliye denominator me 60 aayega, 100 nahi!

questions.q: Due to a reduction of $50 \text{ paise}$ per dozen in the price of bananas, Rohan can buy 1 dozen more bananas for Rs. 66. What is the original price of bananas per dozen?
questions.s:
Core Conceptual Tool: CPR

Pen-Free Observation: Price gira toh consumption badhi. Quadratic equation banane ki bajaye, Rs. 66 ke perfect divisors options me dhundo jinme 0.5 ka gap rakhne par quantity ka gap 1 dozen aaye.

Method 1 (Ninja Technique): Option verification is the king here. Seedha $66/x$ check karo.

Mathematically :-

$$ \text{Check Option C (Rs. 6 /dozen)} \\ \text{Initial Qty} = \frac{66}{6} = 11 \text{ dozen} \\ \text{New Price} = 6 - 0.5 = 5.5 \text{ Rs/dozen} \\ \text{New Qty} = \frac{66}{5.5} = \frac{660}{55} = 12 \text{ dozen} \\ \text{Difference} = 12 - 11 = 1 \text{ dozen (Matches condition)} $$

Method 2 (Concept Builder): Basic price and quantity relation likho aur quadratic equation solve karo.

Mathematically :-

$$ \text{Let original price} = P \\ \frac{66}{P - 0.5} - \frac{66}{P} = 1 \\ 66P - 66(P - 0.5) = P(P - 0.5) \\ 33 = P^2 - 0.5P \\ 2P^2 - P - 66 = 0 \\ (P - 6)(2P + 11) = 0 \implies P = 6 $$

Exam Takeaway: Total expenditure constant wale sawalo me agar quantity gap diya ho, toh hamesha Options uthao, $99 \%$ times answers perfectly divide karte hain total amount ko.

questions.q: The income of Amala is 20% more than that of Bimala and 20% less than that of Kamala. If Kamala's income goes down by 4% and Bimala's goes up by 10%, then the percentage by which Kamala's income would exceed Bimala's is nearest to
questions.s:
Core Conceptual Tool Triggered: Unitary Scaling / Ratio Equalization

The 'Pen-Free' Observation First: Amala (A) common link hai. A aur B ka relation diya hai, fir A aur C (Kamala) ka. A ko barabar karne ke liye LCM lekar starting base fix kar, aage ki percentages smooth ho jayengi.

Method 1 (Ninja Technique / Exam Approach): Dekh bhai aise karna hai... A:B = 120:100 = 6:5. A:C = 80:100 = 4:5. A ko common kar (6 aur 4 ka LCM 12 hai). Ratio A:B:C = 12:10:15. Zero laga kar 120, 100, 150 kar le calculation aasan hogi. Ab C ko 4% down kar toh $150 - 6 = 144$. B ko 10% up kar toh $100 + 10 = 110$. Kamala Bimala ko kitne se exceed kar rhi hai? $144 - 110 = 34$. Percentage = $\frac{34}{110} \times 100 = \frac{340}{11} \approx 30.9\%$. Nearest 31%.

Method 2 (Concept Builder): Direct fractions se ratio set karna, same logic. Agar variables loge (Let C = x) toh time waste hoga.

Future Exam Takeaway: 3 party relative percentage me hamesha 'Common Link' ka LCM le kar standard 100/1000 ki series banalo.

questions.q: In an exam, (x+50)% of the students passed in English, (x+30)% of the students passed in Science and x% of the students passed in both subjects. If $15\%$ of the students failed in both subjects, then find the value of x.
questions.s:
Core Conceptual Tool: JSM (Junior Satisfaction Method) / Set Theory logic

Pen-Free Observation: Dekh bhai, variables cancel out ho jate hain Set theory ke formula mein. Passed log $85\%$ hain. $(x+50) + (x+30) - x = 85$ bas yahi simple mind calc karni thi.

Method 1 (Ninja Technique / Exam Approach): Venn diagram ki simple set equation lagani hai. Options dekho aur tick maro! Mathematically :- $$ \text{Pass } \% = 100\% - 15\% = 85\% \\ P(A \cup B) = P(A) + P(B) - P(A \cap B) \\ 85 = (x + 50) + (x + 30) - x \\ 85 = x + 80 \\ x = 5 $$

Method 2 (Concept Builder): Venn Diagram draw karke parts break karna. Mathematically :- $$ \text{Eng Only} = (x + 50) - x = 50 \\ \text{Sci Only} = (x + 30) - x = 30 \\ \text{Both Pass} = x, \text{Fail} = 15 \\ 50 + 30 + x + 15 = 100 \\ x + 95 = 100 \implies x = 5 $$

Exam Takeaway: Set theory union formula is the fastest way jab overlapping sets ki percentage variables me chal rahi ho.

questions.q: The population of town B is $300\%$ more than that of town A. For the next two years, the population of A increases by x% per year and that of B decreases by the same percentage per year. After 2 years, if the population of A and B become equal, then the value of x is:
questions.s:
Core Conceptual Tool: 2. Successive Change (The Chain Reaction)

Pen-Free Observation: Dekh bhai, $300\%$ zyada ka matlab $4$ guna hota hai ($1:4$ ratio). Aur '2 years' sun ke seedha square root dimag me flash hona chahiye!

Method 1 (Ninja Technique / Exam Approach): Dekh bhai aise karna hai... Equation banegi $A(1 + \frac{x}{100})^2 = B(1 - \frac{x}{100})^2$. B/A ki value $4$ hai. Dono taraf square root le le. Bacha $\frac{1 + x/100}{1 - x/100} = 2$. Cross multiply thok: $1 + \frac{x}{100} = 2 - \frac{2x}{100}$. Idhar udhar shift kar, $\frac{3x}{100} = 1 \implies x = 33\frac{1}{3}$.

Method 2 (Concept Builder): Option se try maar! Agar main $x = 33.33\%$ (yani $\frac{1}{3}$) lu. A badhega: $1 \times \frac{4}{3} \times \frac{4}{3} = \frac{16}{9}$. B ghatega: $4 \times \frac{2}{3} \times \frac{2}{3} = \frac{16}{9}$. Dekh dono barabar ho gaye na? Option checking is deadly here.

Exam Takeaway: Time duration hamesha power banata hai. 2 saal hai toh square, 3 saal ho toh cube ka logic lagana!

questions.q: In an election only two candidates contested. 70% of the voters casted their votes and 425 casted votes declared invalid. Winner got 980 valid votes more than his opponent, if the number of valid votes received by the winner 38% of the number of registered total voters, then find how many registered voters cast their votes?
questions.s:
Tool Triggered: 5. Unitary Scaling

The "Pen-Free" Observation First:
Dekh bhai, tree diagram bana dimaag me. 100x base. Cast 70x. Valid = 70x - 425. Winner le gaya 38x. Loser ko bacha 32x - 425. Margin (Winner - Loser) = 6x + 425 = 980. Toh 6x = 555. Pucha kya hai? Casted votes (70x). Agar 6x = 555, toh 70x direct nikal le.

Method 1 (Ninja Technique):
Equation based margin solving.

Mathematically :-
$$ \text{Reg} = 100x, \quad \text{Cast} = 70x, \quad \text{Valid} = 70x - 425 \\ W = 38x \implies L = 70x - 425 - 38x = 32x - 425 \\ W - L = 980 \implies 38x - (32x - 425) = 980 \\ 6x + 425 = 980 \implies 6x = 555 \implies x = 92.5 \\ \text{Casted} = 70x = 70 \times 92.5 = 6475 $$

Method 2 (Concept Builder):
Direct value logic without x.

Mathematically :-
$$ \text{Total Valid Votes} = W + L \\ L = W - 980 \\ \text{Valid} = W + (W - 980) = 2W - 980 \\ \text{We know, Valid} = 70\% - 425 \text{ and } W = 38\% \\ 70\% - 425 = 2(38\%) - 980 \\ 70\% - 425 = 76\% - 980 \\ 6\% = 555 \\ 70\% = \frac{555}{6} \times 70 = 92.5 \times 70 = 6475 $$

Exam Takeaway: Election format me jab margin absolute terms me ho, waha percentages ki basic equation magic ki tarah kaam karti hai.

questions.q: In an examination, A got 25% marks more than B, B got 10% less than C and C got 25% more than D. If D got 320 marks out of 500, then the marks obtained by A were?
questions.s:
Core Conceptual Tool: Successive Change.

Pen-Free Observation: Dekh bhai, jab bhi sequential ya chain mein percentage change ho (A se B, B se C, C se D), toh beech ke variables alag se nikalne ki zaroorat nahi hai. Sidha unka fraction ratio likh kar multiply maar de, B aur C apne aap cancel out ho jayenge aur direct First (A) aur Last (D) ka ratio bachega. Image me jo tune kiya hai, wahi exact ninja technique hai!

Method 1 (Ninja Technique / Exam Approach): Ratio method lagakar sidha multiply kar de (teri image wali method). Mathematically :-

$$ \frac{A}{B} \times \frac{B}{C} \times \frac{C}{D} = \frac{A}{D} $$

$$ \frac{5}{4} \times \frac{9}{10} \times \frac{5}{4} = \frac{45}{32} $$

$$ \text{Here, } \frac{A}{D} = \frac{45}{32} $$

$$ 32 \text{ units } \rightarrow 320 $$

$$ 45 \text{ units } \rightarrow 450 $$

Method 2 (Concept Builder): Peechhe se pakad aur individually backward chain solve kar (jab intermediate values nikalni pad jayein). Mathematically :-

$$ C = 320 + (320 \times \frac{1}{4}) = 400 $$

$$ B = 400 - (400 \times \frac{1}{10}) = 360 $$

$$ A = 360 + (360 \times \frac{1}{4}) = 450 $$

Exam Takeaway: Chain questions mein agar bas First (A) aur Last (D) ka aapas mein relation nikalna ho, toh unke Multiplier Fractions ko direct aapas mein multiply karna sabse fast approach hota hai.

questions.q: Every day, a wholesale fruit vendor sells $60 \%$ of his total stock. From the remaining stock, he donates $25 \%$ to a local orphanage, and then $20 \%$ of the rest gets spoiled overnight. If exactly 3720 fruits were spoiled over the first two nights combined, how many fruits did he start with on the first day?
questions.s:
Core Conceptual Tool: Successive Change

Pen-Free Observation: Dekh bhai, yahan lagatar 3 reductions ho rahe hain har roz. Pehle $60 \%$ bika, fir bache hue ka $25 \%$ daan kiya, fir jo bacha uska $20 \%$ kharab hua. Fractions ka series lamba hai, isliye $100$ ke bajaye $10000$ base maan le taaki calculations decimals me na phase.

Method 1 (Ninja Technique): Total stock ko ek aisi unit maan lo jo har fraction se easily divide ho jaye. Phir step-by-step successive decrease laga do.

Mathematically :-

$$ \text{Let Initial Stock} = 10000 \text{ units} \\ \text{Day 1: Sells } 60 \% \implies \text{Remaining} = 4000 \\ \text{Donates } 25 \% \text{ of } 4000 = 1000 \implies \text{Rest} = 3000 \\ \text{Night 1 Spoils} = 20 \% \text{ of } 3000 = 600 \\ \text{Day 2 Starts with} = 3000 - 600 = 2400 \text{ units} \\ \text{Day 2: Sells } 60 \% \text{ of } 2400 = 1440 \implies \text{Remaining} = 960 \\ \text{Donates } 25 \% \text{ of } 960 = 240 \implies \text{Rest} = 720 \\ \text{Night 2 Spoils} = 20 \% \text{ of } 720 = 144 \\ \text{Total Spoiled} = 600 + 144 = 744 \text{ units} \\ 744 \text{ units} = 3720 \implies 1 \text{ unit} = 5 \\ \text{Total initial fruits} = 10000 \times 5 = 50000 $$

Method 2 (Concept Builder): Multipliers ko club karke single remaining fraction nikal lo jisse daily calculation aadhi ho jaye.

Mathematically :-

$$ \text{Let Initial Stock} = X \\ \text{Daily Rest Fraction (before spoiling)} = (1 - 0.60) \times (1 - 0.25) \\ = 0.40 \times 0.75 = 0.30 \\ \text{Night 1 Spoiled} = 20 \% \text{ of } 0.30X = 0.06X \\ \text{Remaining for Day 2} = 0.30X - 0.06X = 0.24X \\ \text{Night 2 Spoiled} = 20 \% \text{ of } (0.30 \times 0.24X) = 0.0144X \\ \text{Total Spoiled} = 0.06X + 0.0144X = 0.0744X \\ 0.0744X = 3720 \implies X = \frac{3720}{0.0744} = 50000 $$

Exam Takeaway: Jab din me multi-step reductions hon, toh un sabko club karke ek single remaining multiplier ($0.4 \times 0.75 = 0.3$) bana lena chahiye. Isse next day ki chain equation bohot choti aur fast ho jati hai.
